cells.gaps: The Politique nationale de developpement du numerique 2026-2035 is complete but awaiting its approving decree (June 2026); no adoption on record and no text row. The earlier Politique nationale du numerique 2021-2030 was drafted in 2020 and never adopted (NER-014 says no policy in March 2025). Stage 3 needs adoption and a public text. No cost, reporting, body or finance rows.
cells.note: Instrument: Politique nationale de developpement du numerique 2026-2035, validated and awaiting a decree of approval, so stage 2. Stage 3 needs adoption and a public text.
